title: 骚子营 (哨子营) Saoziying
subtitle: a village · outside the walls · confidence B

model.line: Massing only, not a reconstruction: 25 plain blocks (walls, houses, halls). Its houses, rows and halls are generated to the kind of place, not drawn from a plan of it: assumed (C). The switch `around=0` hides everything outside the walls.

searched: No picture of it found in the catalogues searched for the surroundings.

facts.label: What it was
facts.value: a village outside the garden walls

facts.label: Where
facts.value: today's place names 骚子营 (osm node 10015991608) and 哨子营 (osm node 14238533072), C; its extent, a circle of 80 m, is assumed

facts.label: Note
facts.value: S02 p.57 'some villages of fancy horseback riders just west of the Yuan Ming Yuan' (may be later than Yongzheng); S02 p.54 sketch map draws two small squares 'CIRCUS RIDERS' VILLAGES' west of the YMY and south-east of the Plain Yellow camp, where today's 骚子营/哨子营 lie (B, 1934). Not in 日下 j99-100. Name's origin not found.
